evidence_gaps: Fresh runtime forensics generated within two hours.
Trade-level wallet-delta reconciliation including entry and exit fees, slippage, price impact, platform fees and failed-attempt costs.
Solana realised base/priority/Jito fees, compute usage, platform fees, rent paid/reclaimed, route impact and transaction outcomes.
EVM realised gas, priority/base fee, reverts, replacement or dropped transactions, MEV effects and quote-to-fill deterioration.
Structured STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE attribution with failure reasons and incurred cost.
Per-strategy capital deployed, capital duration, turnover, money-weighted return, drawdown and exposure concentration.
Time-ordered out-of-sample results by chain, venue, asset, liquidity and congestion regime.
Opportunity logs including abstentions and rejected signals, enabling selection-bias and participation analysis.
Sufficient independent observations to estimate uncertainty; no profitability, CANARY or LIVE claim is permitted until these gaps are closed.

proposals.downside_risk: A conservative model may abstain frequently and miss profitable moves; this is preferable to forcing trades without measurable edge.

evidence.detail: EVM entry checks signal age, entry deterioration, sellability and a maximum round-trip loss, but does not require a positive expected net return beyond all costs.
Solana SHADOW entry similarly admits leader-copy candidates based on deterioration and round-trip-loss ceilings rather than a positive expected executable edge.

proposals.expected_effect: Fewer negative-expectancy entries and improved money-weighted net P&L if the edge model survives out-of-sample SHADOW testing.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 eligible SHADOW executions per chain, spanning at least four independent weekly windows and multiple congestion/liquidity regimes.
proposals.rationale: A safe and sellable trade can still have negative expectancy. Copying a leader after latency should require a chain-specific forecast whose conservative expected return exceeds entry and exit costs, impact, failure probability and uncertainty reserve.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay time-ordered leader signals with no lookahead. Enter only when the lower confidence bound of expected net P&L is positive after quoted two-way impact, slippage, all venue/platform fees, Solana priority/Jito/network costs or EVM gas/MEV reserve, and empirical failure cost. Compare against the current gates using identical opportunities and sizing. Stop as unsupported if holdout money-weighted net P&L is non-positive, drawdown worsens, calibration fails, or fewer than 30 eligible executions are observed per chain.

proposals.downside_risk: Conservative cost imputation may understate performance when priority fees are low; report observed and stress-cost results separately.

evidence.detail: SHADOW accounting defaults to fixed 0.00002 SOL entry and exit fees.
The live architecture already models base fees, priority/tip costs, platform-fee equivalents and refundable rent separately.

proposals.expected_effect: More faithful Solana SHADOW net P&L and fewer false-positive strategy candidates.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 contemporaneous Solana quote snapshots and 30 completed round trips across normal and congested periods.
proposals.rationale: Static fees can materially overstate edge during congestion and do not capture route-specific platform fees, priority spend, failed-transaction burn or capital tied in refundable rent.
proposals.shadow_test: Record contemporaneous quote impact, platform fee, estimated compute/base/priority fee, optional tip, rent exposure and empirical failed-attempt cost for every opportunity. Revalue existing SHADOW decisions under observed, p75 and p95 costs. Stop promotion research if net P&L becomes non-positive under observed costs or if missing cost fields exceed 5% of eligible observations.

proposals.downside_risk: More granular telemetry increases schema and reconciliation complexity; unknown attribution must fail closed rather than be guessed.

evidence.detail: Windows store aggregate gross profit, gross loss, fees, slippage and an execution-failure count, but not trade-level capital exposure, failure cost or attribution taxonomy.
Profit factor uses gross profit divided by gross loss while costs are subtracted only from net profit, and metrics do not expose return on deployed capital or time-weighted capital occupancy.
Execution failures are counted separately, but no structured distinction exists between STRATEGY/MARKET loss and EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure.

proposals.expected_effect: More reliable comparisons across strategies, chains, sizing levels and execution regimes.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 completed or failed executable attempts per chain with full reconciliation and no overlapping-window double counting.
proposals.rationale: Durability assessment requires trade-level money weighting and explicit attribution. Reverts, RPC failures, stale quotes and inclusion failures must not be mistaken for market losses, yet their incurred costs still reduce economic P&L.
proposals.shadow_test: For every eligible signal, record capital at risk, timestamps, quoted and realised fills, all costs, status and one mutually exclusive attribution: STRATEGY_MARKET, EXECUTION_INFRASTRUCTURE or NO_TRADE. Reconcile trade-level sums to wallet deltas. Reject the dataset if unreconciled value exceeds 1% of turnover, unknown attribution exceeds 2%, or aggregate and trade-level net P&L differ.

proposals.downside_risk: Longer SHADOW evaluation delays deployment of genuinely useful strategies.

evidence.detail: Lifecycle thresholds permit CANARY-to-PROBATION after 3 trades and PROBATION-to-ACTIVE after 8 trades.
Promotion candidacy uses aggregate positive net P&L and profit factor without an explicit holdout, regime-coverage or confidence-bound requirement.
Evidence status is MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS and explicitly prohibits canary-readiness claims.

proposals.expected_effect: Reduced false promotion from noise, favourable clustering or underestimated execution costs.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 completed trades per chain, four independent weekly windows, two liquidity/congestion regimes, and a holdout containing at least 20 trades per chain.
proposals.rationale: Three or eight outcomes cannot establish durable net expectancy, especially when trade sizes, chain costs and market regimes differ.
proposals.shadow_test: Use immutable time-split holdouts and chain-separated results. Require positive money-weighted net P&L, cost-inclusive profit factor above 1, positive lower confidence bound on expected net return, bounded drawdown, and no unresolved infrastructure cluster. Fail if any holdout chain is non-positive or profitability depends on one asset, wallet, venue or regime.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any current strategy to CANARY or LIVE.
rejected_ideas.reason: Fresh runtime forensics are unavailable, so profitability, canary readiness and live readiness cannot be established.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency or relax sellability, liquidity, simulation, slippage or fee gates.
rejected_ideas.reason: No evidence shows that rejected opportunities possess positive executable edge; relaxing protections could convert abstentions into negative-expectancy trades.

rejected_ideas.idea: Optimise leader-copy selection by raw win count.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count ignores loss magnitude, capital deployed and chain-specific execution costs.

rejected_ideas.idea: Pool Solana and EVM performance into one promotion statistic.
rejected_ideas.reason: Their fee markets, failure modes, liquidity, inclusion mechanics, MEV exposure and rent economics are materially different.

summary: Architecture-only review completed successfully. The repository contains useful fail-closed quote, sellability, simulation and cost controls, but no fresh runtime evidence supports profitability or promotion. Leader-copy entries on both chains can pass safety thresholds without demonstrating positive expected executable edge, SHADOW Solana fees are static, aggregate Strategy Lab metrics lack robust money-weighted and failure-attribution analysis, and the 3/8-trade canary lifecycle is too small for durable inference. These are strategy-evaluation concerns; observed market losses cannot be assessed because runtime outcomes are absent, while execution/infrastructure failures must remain separately classified.
